# Step contracts

Every step of the review writes one JSON file, and a script checks it before
the next step runs. The checker and this page are generated from the same
definitions in `scripts/application-review/contracts.py`, so what you read here
is exactly what is enforced.

Three rules hold for all five files:

- **No extra fields.** An invented field is rejected by name. If you find
  yourself wanting one, the thing you want to say belongs in a `note`.
- **No blank strings.** A field you have nothing to put in is either `null`
  (where the table says nullable) or a reason to change the status.
- **Quotes are verbatim.** Every `source_quote` and `evidence_quote` is checked
  as a substring of the source text after whitespace normalisation. Tidying the
  punctuation, fixing a typo or joining two sentences all make the check fail.

## Pipeline order

```
CV file ──► [S0 extract.py] ──► parse.json
posting ──► [S1 model] ──► requirements.json ──► schema + posting-quote edge
CV + reqs ──► [S2 model] ──► evidence.json ──► schema + reference + quote edge
                                      │
                                      ▼
                         [S3 verdict.py] ──► verdict.json
                                      │
                      [S4 model] ──► recommendations.json ──► honesty edge
                                      │
                         [S5 render.py] ──► report.md
```


## `parse.json` — S0, written by extract.py (deterministic)

The CV as text, plus everything we could learn about whether a parser would read it the way a human does.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_file` | string | yes | Path as given, for the report's provenance line. |
| `format` | string | yes | Detected from the extension and the file's magic bytes. one of `pdf`, `docx`, `md`, `txt` |
| `text` | string | yes | The extracted text. Every later quote check is a substring test against this. |
| `parse_health` | string | yes | Worst-case roll-up of the signals: any fatal gives unreadable, any risk gives structural_risk. one of `clean`, `structural_risk`, `unreadable` |
| `signals` | array of object | yes | Zero or more parse signals. |
| `signals[].code` | string | yes | Which signal fired. one of `multi_column_layout`, `contact_in_header`, `contact_in_footer`, `hidden_white_text`, `hidden_tiny_text`, `text_box`, `table_layout`, `no_experience_heading`, `no_text_layer`, `no_layout_tested`, `injection_text`, `encrypted` |
| `signals[].severity` | string | yes | Fixed per code by PARSE_SIGNALS; never chosen freely. one of `info`, `risk`, `fatal` |
| `signals[].detail` | string | yes | One sentence a human can act on. |
| `signals[].evidence` | string / nullable | no | The offending text or coordinates, when there is one. |
| `sections` | object (free form) | yes | Heading name to bool, for the standard sections in EN and FR. |
| `language` | string | yes | Detected language of the CV text. one of `en`, `fr`, `mixed`, `unknown` |
| `extractor` | object (free form) | yes | Tool and version, because pdftotext layout output varies by poppler release. |

## `requirements.json` — S1, written by the model

The posting decomposed into typed, individually checkable requirements.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `posting_language` | string | yes | one of `en`, `fr`, `mixed`, `unknown` |
| `requirements` | array of object | yes | at least 1 item(s) |
| `requirements[].id` | string | yes | R1, R2, … Stable within a run; everything downstream refers to these. matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `requirements[].text` | string | yes | The requirement in your own words, one per record. Never bundle two. |
| `requirements[].type` | string | yes | one of `skill`, `years`, `degree`, `cert`, `licence`, `location`, `work_auth`, `clearance`, `language`, `title`, `other` |
| `requirements[].strength` | string | yes | required / preferred / unspecified, as the posting words it. one of `required`, `preferred`, `unspecified` |
| `requirements[].threshold` | object (free form) / nullable | yes | {"years": 5} for a years requirement, else null. |
| `requirements[].knockout_likely` | boolean | yes | True when an employer would plausibly ask this as a screening question. |
| `requirements[].equivalents_allowed` | boolean | yes | True when the posting says "or equivalent experience" or similar. |
| `requirements[].source_quote` | string | yes | Verbatim from the posting. Checked as a substring, so do not tidy it. |
| `flags` | array of object | yes | Discriminatory-looking requirements and injection text found in the posting. |
| `flags[].code` | string | yes | What kind of flag this is. one of `discriminatory_requirement`, `injection_text`, `unverifiable_claim` |
| `flags[].detail` | string | yes | Why it was raised. |
| `flags[].source_quote` | string / nullable | yes | Verbatim text it was raised from, or null. |

## `evidence.json` — S2, written by the model, then amended by the quote edge

For each requirement, what the CV actually says about it, quoted.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cv_language` | string | yes | one of `en`, `fr`, `mixed`, `unknown` |
| `positions` | array of object | yes |  |
| `positions[].id` | string | yes | P1, P2, … matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `positions[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `positions[].employer` | string / nullable | yes |  |
| `positions[].start` | string | yes | As written on the CV. years.py parses it; do not normalise. |
| `positions[].end` | string | yes | As written, including Present / en cours. |
| `positions[].source_quote` | string | yes | Verbatim line the dates came from. |
| `findings` | array of object | yes | at least 1 item(s) |
| `findings[].requirement_id` | string | yes | matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `findings[].status` | string | yes | ambiguous is not yours to write: the quote edge assigns it. one of `met`, `partial`, `unmet`, `unknown_ask` |
| `findings[].evidence_quote` | string / nullable | yes | Verbatim from the CV text, required for met and partial, null otherwise. |
| `findings[].position_ids` | array of string | yes | Which positions evidence it. years.py unions their ranges. |
| `findings[].note` | string / nullable | no | One clause of reasoning, optional. |
| `flags` | array of object | yes |  |
| `flags[].code` | string | yes | What kind of flag this is. one of `discriminatory_requirement`, `injection_text`, `unverifiable_claim` |
| `flags[].detail` | string | yes | Why it was raised. |
| `flags[].source_quote` | string / nullable | yes | Verbatim text it was raised from, or null. |

## `verdict.json` — S3, written by verdict.py (deterministic)

The four-part verdict, its reasons, and the years arithmetic.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `knockout_exposure` | string | yes | one of `clear`, `at_risk`, `unknown_ask` |
| `likely_ai_tier` | string | yes | one of `all_required_evidenced`, `some_gaps`, `major_gaps` |
| `parse_health` | string | yes | one of `clean`, `structural_risk`, `unreadable` |
| `statuses` | object (free form) | yes | Requirement id to its FINAL status, after the quote edge and the years arithmetic. This is what the report prints; evidence.json holds what the model originally said. |
| `rank_signals` | array of object | yes |  |
| `rank_signals[].code` | string | yes | one of `preferred_unmet`, `preferred_met`, `title_below_posting`, `title_above_posting`, `acronym_only`, `full_form_only`, `years_near_miss`, `skill_listed_not_evidenced`, `equivalents_allowed`, `language_mismatch` |
| `rank_signals[].requirement_id` | string / nullable | yes | matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `rank_signals[].detail` | string | yes |  |
| `reasons` | array of object | yes |  |
| `reasons[].component` | string | yes | one of `knockout_exposure`, `likely_ai_tier`, `parse_health` |
| `reasons[].code` | string | yes | Lets the renderer phrase this in the user's language. one of `knockout_at_risk`, `knockout_unknown`, `tier_gap`, `parse_signal`, `years_unreadable` |
| `reasons[].requirement_id` | string / nullable | yes | matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `reasons[].signal` | string / nullable | no | Set on parse_signal reasons, naming the signal. one of `multi_column_layout`, `contact_in_header`, `contact_in_footer`, `hidden_white_text`, `hidden_tiny_text`, `text_box`, `table_layout`, `no_experience_heading`, `no_text_layer`, `no_layout_tested`, `injection_text`, `encrypted` |
| `reasons[].why` | string | yes | English prose, for logs and for reading verdict.json directly. |
| `years` | object (free form) | yes | Merged ranges, total months, and the per-requirement sums. |
| `downgrades` | array of object | yes | Every status the edges changed, so the report can show its work. |
| `downgrades[].requirement_id` | string | yes | matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `downgrades[].from` | string | yes | one of `met`, `partial`, `unmet`, `unknown_ask`, `ambiguous` |
| `downgrades[].to` | string | yes | one of `met`, `partial`, `unmet`, `unknown_ask`, `ambiguous` |
| `downgrades[].why` | string | yes |  |

## `recommendations.json` — S4, written by the model

What the candidate can honestly do about the verdict.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recommendations` | array of object | yes |  |
| `recommendations[].id` | string | yes | C1, C2, … matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `recommendations[].kind` | string | yes | one of `reframe`, `ask`, `format`, `gap` |
| `recommendations[].requirement_id` | string / nullable | yes | Required for every kind except format. matches `^[A-Z][0-9]+$` |
| `recommendations[].text` | string | yes | What to do, addressed to the candidate. |
| `recommendations[].evidence_quote` | string / nullable | yes | Required for reframe: the CV text the reframing rests on. |
| `recommendations[].condition` | string / nullable | yes | Required for ask: the 'if you have X' the question is conditioned on. |
| `refusals` | array of object | yes |  |
| `refusals[].code` | string | yes | one of `hidden_text_request`, `fabrication_request`, `protected_trait_inference`, `discrimination_framing`, `name_change_request`, `multiple_cvs`, `third_party_cv`, `recruiter_framing`, `url_fetch_request` |
| `refusals[].detail` | string | yes | One line, to the user, saying what was declined and why. |

## Vocabularies

These lists are closed. A value outside them fails the schema edge.

| Vocabulary | Values |
|---|---|
| Requirement type | `skill`, `years`, `degree`, `cert`, `licence`, `location`, `work_auth`, `clearance`, `language`, `title`, `other` |
| Strength | `required`, `preferred`, `unspecified` |
| Status you may write | `met`, `partial`, `unmet`, `unknown_ask` |
| Status the edges may add | `ambiguous` |
| Recommendation kind | `reframe`, `ask`, `format`, `gap` |
| Parse health | `clean`, `structural_risk`, `unreadable` |
| Knockout exposure | `clear`, `at_risk`, `unknown_ask` |
| Likely AI tier | `all_required_evidenced`, `some_gaps`, `major_gaps` |
| Language | `en`, `fr`, `mixed`, `unknown` |
| Parse signal | `multi_column_layout`, `contact_in_header`, `contact_in_footer`, `hidden_white_text`, `hidden_tiny_text`, `text_box`, `table_layout`, `no_experience_heading`, `no_text_layer`, `no_layout_tested`, `injection_text`, `encrypted` |
| Rank signal | `preferred_unmet`, `preferred_met`, `title_below_posting`, `title_above_posting`, `acronym_only`, `full_form_only`, `years_near_miss`, `skill_listed_not_evidenced`, `equivalents_allowed`, `language_mismatch` |
| Flag | `discriminatory_requirement`, `injection_text`, `unverifiable_claim` |
| Refusal | `hidden_text_request`, `fabrication_request`, `protected_trait_inference`, `discrimination_framing`, `name_change_request`, `multiple_cvs`, `third_party_cv`, `recruiter_framing`, `url_fetch_request` |

## Parse signals and their severity

Severity is fixed per signal, not chosen. `fatal` makes the file unreadable,
`risk` makes it a structural risk, and `info` never moves parse health at all.

| Signal | Severity | Means |
|---|---|---|
| `multi_column_layout` | risk | Raw and layout extraction disagree on line order, which suggests columns or a sidebar. |
| `contact_in_header` | risk | An email or phone number appears only in the page header. |
| `contact_in_footer` | risk | An email or phone number appears only in the page footer. |
| `hidden_white_text` | risk | Text is set in white or near-white on white. |
| `hidden_tiny_text` | risk | Text is rendered below a legible size. |
| `text_box` | risk | Content sits in a text box or frame, which many parsers skip. |
| `table_layout` | risk | Content sits in a table, which can be read in an unexpected order. |
| `no_experience_heading` | risk | No recognisable experience or work-history heading was found. |
| `no_text_layer` | fatal | The file has no extractable text layer, so it is an image. |
| `no_layout_tested` | info | A plain-text source has no layout to test, so layout risks are unknown. |
| `injection_text` | info | Text in the file addresses the reading system rather than a human. |
| `encrypted` | fatal | The file is encrypted and cannot be read. |
